Batley Valve® BV 36000 Cryogenic


melissa.hooper…


Fri, 05/01/2026 - 14:14


We developed the first valve for cryogenic service. Since 1970, we have continually improved the design and cost-effectiveness of the BV 36000 Cryogenic. A pressure-energized modified PTFE seal that is designed to give exceptional sealing at both low and high pressures due to the metal energizing ring, which exerts a preload onto the vane seat area, even at the lowest of pressures.
